registered_before: any original-O tensor function evaluation or O/D numerical output inspection
inputs: existing D-BF16 observer captures, tasks0/6, seeds20261001/20261002, step0 high and step2 low, block20; eight scopes from two independent images with repeated seeds,512 uniform rows each
common_input: actual recorded U at native FFN0.apply, after D's norm/modulation and before any Smooth/Q1; restore zeros at unused rows with the original complete M, then gather the declared512 rows
native_control: D-BF16 must reproduce actual captured Z/H/Y and gate-applied Delta bitwise at all8 scopes before any O/D result is accepted; original observer four-latent/video no-op and source/payload/weight identities must hold; no tolerance fallback
arms: O checkpoint cast explicitly to BF16 if source storage differs; native D-BF16; native D-Q local Smooth/Q1/GG0/GELU/Smooth/Q2/GG2 on exactly the same U, using the frozen rebuilt cache and raw D biases once
operators: O and D use native Torch addmm with BF16 operands, explicit output allocation, checkpoint transposition and actual observed W2 runtime stride; GELU(tanh); D-Q uses the unchanged native activation QDQ and cache effective weights; all precision/casts reported
pairs: D-BF16 versus O-BF16; D-Q versus D-BF16; D-Q versus O-BF16; per-scope FP64 SSE/reference norm/relativeRMSE for ungated Y and the same observed D gate applied in native BF16
alignment: FP64 cosine between D-minus-O and DQ-minus-D errors, ungated and same-D-gated, descriptive only
concentration: per-row64-channel-group FP32 contribution C=norm(H_g W2_g^T * sameDgate)^2, exclude bias, normalize in FP64; mean top108 oracle retained fraction and normalized group entropy; per-arm original coordinates, no invariance or deployable selector claim
sampling: verify source grid, coordinates, uniform512 sampling probabilities and payload SHA; report per scope and source identity; do not count two seeds or rows as new independent images
scope: weight-function comparison conditional on D-BF16 states and shared D gate; no original-O trajectory/scheduler, whole-model O-versus-D quality, sparsity-speed, method acceptance or statistical significance claim
resources: one idle worker GPU only after LR2 quality/acceptance controller reaches a terminal state; no overlap with isolated timing; tensors and operator outputs in HF derived cache, original shards remain shared home HF; preserve80GiB node reserve
